usedFor: Membrain holds sales projects and contacts, and Calendly makes a booking link for each with “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sales Project Created” in Membrain, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new sales project needs a first meeting, so a booking link is ready to send.

watchOut: Every Membrain trigger here is polling, so “Create Scheduling Link” runs after a scheduled check.
